description: This file defines the GroupNotActiveException class, which extends AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException, representing a specific exception thrown when a group is not active.

classes.name: GroupNotActiveException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that a specific group is not active in the system.

methods.name: GroupNotActiveException
methods.description: Constructor that creates the exception with a message indicating the group ID that is not active.

calls: super("error.msg.group.not.active.exception", "The Group with id `' + groupId + '` is not active", groupId)
